snippet.title: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus - Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2017940/Pony_Island_2_Panda_Circus/

Starring SungWon Cho, Arian Moayed, Caitlin Reilly, and Kevin Saxby.

Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

http://www.ponyisland2.com
